title: CI no longer compares jellyscale with Jellyfin or checks answers against Jellyfin's schema
description: Carries out D-110's retirement of the differential tier and the Jellyfin schema check, which no open task did: every merge-queue run pays for them (the differential job alone about 6 runner-minutes) to prove a Jellyfin likeness the product no longer promises (D-107). Serves the operator through delivery: every later task lands through a cheaper, faster queue. The jellyfin-web browser gate stays until the cutover (JS-194), as the automated proof that watching works in a real player (D-20261127-js198-land). No dependencies.
acceptanceCriteria: No CI job, required check or shard count starts a Jellyfin server or expects a differential gate; the merge queue passes without them.

The tooling and data that serve only the comparison or the Jellyfin schema are gone from the repository: the differential tier and its requests, normalisation and allowlist, the third-party client and SDK replays it runs, the Jellyfin schema and the script that makes it, and the Jellyfin coverage and route listings. Anything JS-183's own conformance check reuses stays, with no Jellyfin schema as its input.
The jellyfin-web e2e gates still run in the queue and still fail when watching breaks; they no longer check answers against Jellyfin's schema.

Every test that proves application behaviour and only uses a captured Jellyfin shape is kept, or rewritten to assert the behaviour directly, never deleted; the pull request lists each such test with what it still proves. The captures that invariants cite stay until JS-194's ledger decides them.

AGENTS.md, docs/testing.md, docs/status.md and DOMAINS.md no longer describe or cite the retired tier or schema check; a statement that leaned on it is rewritten, citing D-110 and this task's decision.
source: Owner, 2026-11-27: remove the Jellyfin comparisons from CI and the repo; D-110; D-20261127-retire-jellyfin-comparisons
notes: Not the cutover: Jellyfin routes, their invariants and the jellyfin-web gate leave in JS-194.
